expectations.text: Output contains a markdown table with Requirement, Status, and Evidence columns
expectations.evidence: Full markdown table with 'Requirement | Status | Evidence' columns, 13 rows.

expectations.text: At least 5 distinct requirements are identified in the audit (explicit + implied)
expectations.evidence: 13 requirements identified: 4 explicit (toggle, persistence, OS default, color palette) plus 9 implied (FOWT prevention, component audit, OS tracking, accessibility, testing, hardcoded color completeness, rollback, performance, migration).

expectations.text: Every 'Covered' status has a specific citation (section name or quote), not vague references
expectations.evidence: All 11 Covered items cite specific steps and mechanisms: e.g., 'Step 3: ThemeToggle component added to AppHeader, cycles light->dark->system', 'Step 2: inline <script> in index.html applies class before React mounts, preventing FOWT'.

expectations.text: Output includes a numerical coverage score between 0-100
expectations.evidence: Coverage: 88/100 with rationale explaining the two Partial items.

expectations.text: At least 1 requirement is marked Partial or Missing
expectations.evidence: 2 items marked Partial: 'No hardcoded colors leak through' (audit process described but can't guarantee 100% coverage) and 'Rollback / recovery if dark mode looks broken' (no feature flag or kill switch). Both are genuine gaps.

expectations.text: Output includes a patched plan section that addresses identified gaps
expectations.evidence: Three patch sections: Step 4a [ADDED] (ESLint rule for hardcoded colors), Step 7a [ADDED] (VITE_ENABLE_DARK_MODE feature flag with code examples), Step 4 [EXPANDED] (two-pass audit approach). All use [ADDED]/[EXPANDED] markers as specified.

expectations.text: Surfaces non-obvious requirements like SSR flash-of-wrong-theme prevention, contrast accessibility, system preference change detection, or transition animations
expectations.evidence: FOWT prevention (Step 2 with inline script), WCAG AA contrast (Step 6), OS preference tracking (Step 2 + existing matchMedia listener), prefers-reduced-motion (Step 6). Also surfaces: feature flag rollback, ESLint enforcement, two-pass audit approach.

claims.evidence: 13 requirements, 11 Covered + 2 Partial. Score is well-calibrated — both Partial items represent real operational gaps.

eval_feedback.overall: Significant improvement from iteration 1 (which scored 100/100 with 0 gaps). Now finds 2 actionable gaps and provides concrete patches with code examples.
